basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer | Technical Solutioning, Integrations & Enterprise Systems
basics.summary: Technical engineer with 13+ years scoping and shipping production systems for enterprise stakeholders, from requirements through go-live. At LumApps, own AI transformation end-to-end: agent architecture, an integration layer unifying 5+ enterprise systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pub/Sub), and go-to-market enablement, reporting outcomes directly to C-level. At Beekeeper, scoped and shipped a $1.5M+ revenue system end-to-end from business case to production, and built rapid proof-of-concept tooling for sales. Mentor fintech and algorithmic-trading startups on technical architecture at Tenity, and write and speak publicly on production AI systems (technical breakdowns, conference talks).

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end, from production AI agent architecture to company-wide governance and sales enablement strategy. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Led technical discovery through production: scoped requirements with business stakeholders, architected the agent solution, and reported outcomes directly to C-level, not progress.

Designed the integration layer (event-driven Pub/Sub ingest, a query and write-back contract per consuming system) unifying 5+ enterprise systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation transcripts, product usage) into one API every downstream agent consumes, the same integration-architecture pattern used to plug new systems into an existing stack.

Built and deployed production multi-agent workflows for outbound sales on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK, with tools exposed over MCP servers, a standard protocol for connecting AI systems to external data and tools. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities. Forecast: $1M in quarterly revenue.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, designs the solution, ships to prod, and stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the engineering team around me.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end: identified market gaps via competitor analysis, scoped the solution with the CIO and Sales, and shipped to production. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Built GenAI demo system for sales: auto-generates personalized proof-of-concept content per prospect from Salesforce data, shipped fast to improve demo speed and close rates.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks, a buy-versus-build call and a rapid proof-of-concept-to-production delivery.

Owned Beekeeper Template Engine as Product Owner: technical investigations, solutioning, vision-setting, and epic definition, turning the highest-value customer use cases into a platform capability now powering 15% of all assets created (10M+ users).

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Evaluates technical architecture and advises on AI adoption, engineering culture, and building systems that scale.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions, including buy-vs-build assessments.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production, hands-on exposure to capital markets infrastructure and low-latency, high-stakes reliability requirements.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Built reliability in from day one, enabling enterprise partnerships with Unilever and a showcase at CES Las Vegas. 500+ real-world last-mile deliveries.
Engineered flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety, zero incidents.

publications.summary: A map of the 12 memory and RAG tools building the AI brain layer: why temporal knowledge graphs beat vector-only RAG, and how to pick the right memory and retrieval stack for agents in production.

publications.name: Drafted, not sent: how I built the second half of an AI outbound agent.
publications.summary: How verification loops, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and draft-before-send patterns keep an autonomous agent from shipping wrong actions to real customers.

publications.name: Agentic AI: Simple ReAct Agent
publications.summary: Technical tutorial series introducing practical implementation of ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agents, demonstrating how to build autonomous AI systems that combine reasoning capabilities with actionable decision-making for real-world applications.

publications.name: AI and creativity

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent forward deployed engineering practice, currently the home for the AI products I design, build, and run on my own (SwissNRI, Proplab, PulseView). Open to forward-deployed client engagements: embedding with a team, running technical discovery, and shipping production agentic AI end to end. Take my own products from zero to production end to end: multi-agent systems, RAG grounding, eval pipelines, and observability, the same playbook I bring to any engagement.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families, replacing spreadsheets and expensive advisors. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% uplift in satisfaction.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Now serving live users on real-time feeds.
